# Finkelstein Lab

> The lab of Ilya J. Finkelstein, Professor of Molecular Biosciences at UT Austin. Builds single-molecule and high-throughput biophysical methods (DNA curtains, CHAMP/NGS-chip repurposing, microfluidic single-cell arrays) to study how molecular machines edit and repair genomes: CRISPR-Cas adaptive immunity and nuclease engineering, eukaryotic DNA double-strand-break repair and homologous recombination, mismatch repair, retron-based genome editing, and biosensing. Also expert-witness and technical consulting in biotechnology and gene-editing patent matters.

## Overview

- [Research](https://finkelsteinlab.org/research/): current research programs

## News and press

> Local archives of journalism and press releases about the lab. The linked title is the archived copy hosted here; `Source` is the article as originally published; `PDF` is a print snapshot of the original page. Publisher is the outlet that ran the story, not this lab.

{%- assign archives = site.pages | where: 'layout', 'news-md' %}
{%- assign news_archives = archives | where_exp: 'a', "a.url contains '/assets/md/news/'" | sort: 'date_published' | reverse %}

### Lab news
{% for a in news_archives %}
{%- assign a_title = a.title | replace: '&#945;', 'α' | replace: '&#124;', '|' | strip %}{% assign a_outlet = a.source_name | default: '' | strip %}{% assign a_date = a.date_published | default: '' | date: '%Y-%m-%d' %}{% assign a_arch = a.archived | default: '' | date: '%Y-%m-%d' %}{% assign a_desc = a.description | default: '' | strip %}{% assign a_src = a.source_url | default: '' | strip %}{% assign a_pdf = a.pdf | default: '' | strip -%}
- [{{ a_title }}]({{ site.production_url }}{{ a.url }}){% if a_outlet != '' %}: {{ a_outlet }}{% endif %}{% if a_date != '' %}, {{ a_date }}{% endif %}.{% if a_desc != '' %} {{ a_desc }}{% endif %}{% if a_src != '' %} Source: {{ a_src }}.{% endif %}{% if a_pdf != '' %} PDF: {{ site.production_url }}{{ a_pdf }}.{% endif %}{% if a_arch != '' %} Archived: {{ a_arch }}.{% endif %}
{% endfor %}

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://finkelsteinlab.org/sitemap.txt): plain-text list of every URL on the site
- [Full text and abstracts](https://finkelsteinlab.org/llms-full.txt): citation plus abstract for every publication
- [Markdown sources](https://github.com/{{ site.repository }}/tree/master/assets/md): every full-text and archive page above is generated from a Markdown file in this public repository. Fetch the source instead of scraping the HTML by replacing `https://finkelsteinlab.org/assets/md/<path>/` with `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{{ site.repository }}/master/assets/md/<path>/index.md`. Each archive page also declares its own source as `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">`.
